00046 class DelayBaseUGenInternal : public ProxyOwnerUGenInternal
00047 {
00048 public:
00049     DelayBaseUGenInternal(const int numInputs, 
00050                           UGen const& input, 
00051                           UGen const& delayTime, 
00052                           Buffer const& delayBuffer, 
00053                           const bool isMultiTap) throw();
00054     UGenInternal* getChannel(const int channel) throw() = 0;        // final subclasses now MUST implment this..                        
00055     
00056     enum Inputs { Input, DelayTime, NumInputs };
00057     
00058 protected:
00059 
00060     // perhaps move these lookups to Buffer?
00061     inline float lookupIndexN(const int index)
00062     {
00063         return bufferSamples[index];
00064     }
00065     
00066     // must make this more efficient
00067     inline float lookupIndexL(const float fIndex)
00068     {
00069         const int iIndex0 = (int)fIndex;
00070         const int iIndex1 = iIndex0+1;
00071         const float frac = fIndex - (float)iIndex0;
00072         const float value0 = bufferSamples[iIndex0];
00073         float value1;
00074         
00075         if(iIndex1 == delayBuffer_.size()) {
00076             value1 = bufferSamples[0];
00077         } else {    
00078             value1 = bufferSamples[iIndex1];
00079         }
00080         
00081         return value0 + frac * (value1 - value0);
00082     }
00083     
00084     // 0 is one ahead, 1 is this, 2 is on behind, 3 is two behind
00085     //static float cubicinterp(float x, float y0, float y1, float y2, float y3)
00086     inline float lookupIndexC(const float fIndex)
00087     {
00088         const int iIndex1 = (int)fIndex;
00089         const int iIndex0 = iIndex1+1;
00090         const int iIndex2 = iIndex1-1;
00091         const int iIndex3 = iIndex1-2;
00092         const float y0 = bufferSamples[iIndex0];
00093         const float y1 = bufferSamples[iIndex1];
00094         const float y2 = bufferSamples[iIndex2];
00095         const float y3 = bufferSamples[iIndex3];
00096         
00097         const float frac = fIndex - iIndex1;
00098         
00099         // 4-point, 3rd-order Hermite (x-form)
00100         float c0 = y1;
00101         float c1 = 0.5f * (y2 - y0);
00102         float c2 = y0 - 2.5f * y1 + 2.f * y2 - 0.5f * y3;
00103         float c3 = 0.5f * (y3 - y0) + 1.5f * (y1 - y2);
00104         
00105         return ((c3 * frac + c2) * frac + c1) * frac + c0;
00106     }
00107     
00108     Buffer delayBuffer_;
00109     const double delayBufferSize;
00110     float *bufferSamples;
00111     int bufferWritePos;
00112 };

00153 class RecircBaseUGenInternal : public DelayBaseUGenInternal
00154 {
00155 public: 
00156     RecircBaseUGenInternal(UGen const& input, 
00157                            UGen const& delayTime, 
00158                            UGen const& decayTime, 
00159                            Buffer const& delayBuffer) throw();
00160     
00161     enum Inputs { Input, DelayTime, DecayTime, NumInputs };
00162     
00163 protected:
00164 
00165     inline float calcFeedback(float delay, float decay)
00166     {
00167         if (delay == 0.f) {
00168             return 0.f;
00169         } else if (decay > 0.f) {
00170             return (float)std::exp(log001 * delay / decay);
00171         } else if (decay < 0.f) {
00172             return (float)-std::exp(log001 * delay / -decay);
00173         } else {
00174             return 0.f;
00175         }
00176     }
00177     
00178     float currentDelay;
00179     float currentDecay;
00180     float feedback;
00181 };

00287     {
00288     public:
00297         RecircBaseChainLink(const float maximumDelayTime = 0.2f, 
00298                             ValueArray const& delayTime = 0.2f, 
00299                             ValueArray const& decayTime = 0.2f)
00300         :   maximumDelayTime_(maximumDelayTime),
00301             delayTime_(delayTime),
00302             decayTime_(decayTime)
00303         {
00304         }
00305         
00310         UGen createEvent(UGen const& input, const int eventCount)
00311         {
00312             return RecircBaseType::AR(input, maximumDelayTime_, delayTime_, decayTime_);
00313         }
00314         
00315     private:
00316         float maximumDelayTime_;
00317         ValueArray const& delayTime_;
00318         ValueArray const& decayTime_;
00319     };
00320     
00331     static UGen AR(UGen const& input, 
00332                    const int size,
00333                    const float maximumDelayTime = 0.2f, 
00334                    ValueArray const& delayTime = 0.2f, 
00335                    ValueArray const& decayTime = 0.2f)
00336     {
00337         int numChannels = input.getNumChannels();
00338         if(delayTime.size() > numChannels)
00339             numChannels = delayTime.size();
00340         if(decayTime.size() > numChannels)
00341             numChannels = decayTime.size();
00342             
00343         return Chain<RecircBaseChainLink>::AR(RecircBaseChainLink(maximumDelayTime, 
00344                                                                   delayTime, 
00345                                                                   decayTime),
00346                                               input, size, numChannels);
00347     }
00348     
00349 private:
00350     RecircBaseChain();
00351 };
